coordinates: Unconverted signed source x,y,z integers. Positions in original source units; normals in Q12. No axis flip, scale, pose, float normalization or triangulation applied.

texture.indices_encoding: One byte per4bpp index0..15, row major, native TPAGE0x3B at VRAMword704,256.
texture.palettes_encoding: Little-endian raw16-bit PSX RGB555/STP words. Rows0..15 main row=(main_updates-1)&15; rows16..23 companion row=16+(global_game_frame&7). Word0 transparent; bit15 retained.

packet_notes.colors: colors is one RGB per original corner. Lit textured packets omit stored colors; parser supplies source emitter RGB128. stored_colors preserves the original RGB/pad bytes when present.
packet_notes.ordering: Primitives remain in TMD stream order; vertices/normals/UV/colors retain original polygon corner order. corner_triangles records GPU quad subdivision only; native quad is still a single culling/order primitive.
packet_notes.shield: Original static source colors/modes are retained. Runtime80181478 replaces colors per source-Y band and sets G3/G4 semi-transparency; renderer must apply that update.
